description: Search the events an addon can register with frame:RegisterEvent, and show each event's payload arguments in order. Use this whenever writing an OnEvent handler, so the argument list matches what the client sends.

flavor.description: Game client to answer for. Defaults to WOW_DEFAULT_FLAVOR, or retail.

query.description: Event name or fragment, e.g. COMBAT_LOG or BAG_UPDATE.

name: wow_api_event_search
title: Search in-game events
